habitat: Evergreen forest; deciduous woodland; areas with dense climbing plants; gardens; and plantations
story: Few birds capture the imagination quite like the Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill (Ocyceros gingalensis). As a member of the Bucerotidae family, it has carved out a unique niche in Evergreen forest; deciduous woodland; areas with dense climbing plants; gardens; and plantations. Its conservation status is Least Concern (LC), a classification that drives crucial research and protection efforts. The Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill's presence is a vital sign of its ecosystem's health, making its preservation a priority. This poster is a tribute to the Sri Lanka Grey Hornbill, celebrating its role in the natural world and inspiring a deeper appreciation for biodiversity.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
